commands.description: List every command
commands.name: HELP

commands.description: Describe the app and every command with its arguments
commands.name: app.describe

args.window: optional compose window name; default most recently focused

commands.description: Read or answer the open dialog
commands.name: email.dialog

commands.description: Probe Email
commands.name: email.ping

args.window: optional compose window name; default most recently focused

commands.description: The whole window state: accounts (no secret), selection, mode, lists shown, compose, dialogs and UI shape
commands.name: email.info

commands.description: The app's commands with labels, shortcuts and enablement
commands.name: email.actions

commands.description: The accounts in tree order: settings, whether a password is held (has_password), connection state and error; never a password
commands.name: email.accounts

commands.description: The account's mailboxes from its server, with roles, parents and counts
commands.name: email.mailboxes

args.mailbox: optional mailbox id (default the selected one)

commands.description: One page of a mailbox, newest first, with the total count
commands.name: email.list

commands.description: Emails matching text, in one mailbox or all
commands.name: email.search

commands.description: One email's headers and text body
commands.name: email.get

commands.description: Close the window
commands.name: email.quit

args.window: optional compose window name for compose actions; default most recently focused

commands.description: Run one app command by id, as its menu item or shortcut would
commands.name: email.execute

args.ca_path: optional absolute PEM path or null
args.id: optional account id (absent: a new account)
args.identities: optional list of {id, name, address, signature, reply_to}; replaces the account's identities, [] for none
args.name: string
args.password: optional string, kept only in the app's secrets file

commands.description: Create or update an account in settingsd; answers {id} once settingsd accepts
commands.name: email.account.set

commands.description: Remove an account from settingsd (and its password); the default resets with it
commands.name: email.account.remove

args.id: account id (for a forget, any account id, one settingsd no longer holds included)

commands.description: Keep an account's password in the app's secrets file and reconnect; write-only. An empty password forgets it and answers {forgotten: bool}
commands.name: email.account.password.set

commands.description: Connect an account again
commands.name: email.account.connect

args.id: account id, or null for the first enabled one

commands.description: Make an account the compose default in settingsd
commands.name: email.account.default

commands.description: Create a mailbox; answers {id}
commands.name: email.mailbox.create

commands.description: Rename a mailbox
commands.name: email.mailbox.rename

commands.description: Delete an empty mailbox
commands.name: email.mailbox.delete

commands.description: Open an email in the reader; answers once it is loaded
commands.name: email.open

args.ids: email id or list of ids

commands.description: Set or clear read and flagged, one Email/set per 500 ids; answers {ids, done, failed: [{id, reason}], partial} (partial is true when some ids changed and some failed) and is refused only when every id failed
commands.name: email.mark

args.ids: email id or list of ids

commands.description: Move emails to a mailbox, one Email/set per 500 ids; answers {ids, mailbox, done, failed: [{id, reason}], partial} (partial is true when some ids changed and some failed) and is refused only when every id failed
commands.name: email.move

args.ids: email id or list of ids
args.junk: bool: true moves to the Junk mailbox, false back to the inbox

commands.description: Mark emails as junk or not junk by moving them into or out of the Junk mailbox; maild trains its spam filter (spam or ham) on the move
commands.name: email.junk

args.ids: email id or list of ids

commands.description: Move emails to Trash, or destroy them, one Email/set per 500 ids; answers {ids, destroyed, done, failed: [{id, reason}], partial} (partial is true when some ids changed and some failed) and is refused only when every id failed
commands.name: email.delete

args.attachments: optional list of absolute file paths
args.document: optional absolute mail document path; excludes all inline message fields
args.references: optional ordered Message-ID string or list
args.subject: string

commands.description: Send an email without the dialog
commands.name: email.send
